rhea_docs: Quick heads-up  opened PR to the Optimize toolkit migration doc with a tiny checklist, a legacy->alias quant_profile table, and three micro-snippets (dialog, batch, streaming). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4019

devbot: PR #4019 opened by rhea_docs · labels: docs,optkit,needs-review

marc_eng: thanks. quick Q: is this purely docs or are we changing any default behavior? customers should not be surprised on upgrade.

rhea_docs: docs-only. added a bold callout: "NO runtime changes; alias names are for reference and optional renames only." Also included a one-line rename helper if teams want to standardize: `git grep -l "quant_profile:" | xargs sed -i "s/q8_0/q8_0_aliased/g"`

yuki_opt: please include a streaming snippet showing prefetch interaction. prefetch helps throughput but hurts first-token latency on streams. show `prefetch_kv=False` for streaming/interactive examples.

rhea_docs: good point  added three labeled snippets under "Quick snippets":
```python
# dialog (low-latency)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_aliased')
print(c.generate('User: Hey\nBot:'))
```
```python
# batch (throughput)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile='q8_aliased')
print(c.batch_generate(['Summarize: ...'] * 64))
```
```python
# streaming (real-time responses)
from redwood import OptimizeClient
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(streaming=True, batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_aliased')
for chunk in c.stream_generate('Tell me a short story'):
    print(chunk)
```

dana_pm: tiny product request  step that links to Console should point at /console/telemetry and call out that rollouts will respect alias mappings. left inline comment. Also ask to add a one-line release-note blurb.

rhea_docs: fixed Console link to /console/telemetry, rebased and pushed. added a short "When to disable KV prefetch" note: "Disable for short-turn dialog or streaming (seq < 48) to keep first-token p50 low." Pasted microbench snippets for reviewers:
```
[smoke] dialog seq=16 p50=29ms toks/s=160
[smoke] batch seq=256 p50=118ms toks/s=520
[smoke] streaming seq=12 first_token_p50=42ms
```

marc_eng: LGTM from eng after one tiny nit about wording in the alias table header (suggest "alias mapping" instead of "aliases").

yuki_opt: LGTM from optimization. will monitor ticket volume after merge. added an internal note to check telemetry for prefetch-related regressions.

dana_pm: LGTM from product once CI is green and release-note is added.

rhea_docs: merging now. will add a 1-line release-note and ping #support to watch for any migration questions in the next 72h. :tada:
